electric-cyan.$description: Electric Cyan — Accent text, accent borders, the video card surface, the gradient highlight on the product screen — the only chromatic pulse in an otherwise achromatic system

sky-signal.$description: Sky Signal — Secondary cyan for gradient stops and product screen illumination

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Card surface base, gradient shadow stop — anchors the teal product card in darkness

void-black.$description: Void Black — Page canvas, primary background — the uninterrupted dark field

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Alternative near-black surface when the canvas shifts fractionally off-pure-black

midnight-surface.$description: Midnight Surface — Elevated surface — cards, panels, overlay containers sitting one step above the void

graphite.$description: Graphite — Mid-tier surface and neutral button fills — the interactive control surface

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary card surface for stacked or grouped containers

slate.$description: Slate — Deep shadow surface and tertiary elevation

steel-gray.$description: Steel Gray — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Primary text, light surface fills, download button, high-contrast elements

ghost-gray.$description: Ghost Gray — Subtle highlight wash and faint surface luminosity

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

instrument-serif.$description: Display and heading — italicized editorial serif at dramatic scale. The brand wordmark reaches 400px filling the viewport; section headlines land at 64–96px. Negative letter-spacing tightens the serif into compact magazine-display density.

dm-mono.$description: Mono UI chrome — labels, tags, metadata, button text, the 'MADE BY EVERY' stamp, the download button label, feature annotations. Reads as system metadata. The 32px usage appears in product device labels.

geist.$description: Body text — 17px single weight for paragraphs and descriptions. The slightly larger-than-default body size (17 vs 16) gives copy room to breathe against the dense UI chrome.

system-ui.$description: Fallback body and link text — appears in utility contexts where a system font is appropriate

sf-pro-display-regular.$description: SF Pro Display Regular — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
